item.title: Configuration Changes
item.description: Trustgrid records information about changes users make to all configuration. This can be helpful when troubleshooting recent changes. Configuration changes for the entire organization are available by navigating to Operations > Changes. Configuration changes table showing recent changes across the organization Viewing configuration changes requires audits::read:config permissions. The following information is shown for each change: Field Name Description Date When the change was made IP The IP address from which the change originated Event The type of change (delete/create/change/action).
